_README: THE MENU. This file, copied to static/cadabra-script.json, is the ON switch for Mr. Cadabra's floating layer.
Delete that copy and he is off everywhere, with no page change and no flag. The two files are kept IDENTICAL (ruletests pins it).
cadabra.js refuses to mount on a page this file does not name (PRESENCE_RULES.md rule 18): the pages block below is the whole roster.
Adding a NEW behaviour is code (see BEHAVIOURS in cadabra.js). Scheduling one is editing this file.
_CHANGE_NOTES: Keep newest at top. JSON has no comments, so the notes live here.

2026-09-23 (xr): THE PENCIL IN THE SCRIPTED LANE (project 5 of the 09-14 deep dive). session.html rings beat.<name> for every scripted beat; this menu says what he does there: beat.picture / teach / worked / practice_intro / recap / walk-back -> PRESENT (new in cadabra.js: he comes to the newest board block in the write pose, tip on its corner, and holds while the line is spoken -- hold "voice"); beat.praise -> pleased, then UNDERLINE "= $answer" (the right answer the page rang the moment with) on the board; beat.why -> the teaching face at home (the why is over the goal card); beat.second-look -> the listening face (he is beside the miss already); beat.ask -> release (out of the way while the student works). dock "board": his home is the board's top-right corner and the roaming drift is off. height 146 -> 200, handSize 26 -> 36 (Jim: a bigger pencil). Version bumped. Both copies identical.

2026-09-22 (xn): THE MISS HAS A FACE (project 4 of the 09-14 deep dive). pages.session.answer.wrong: he now COMFORTS at the `miss` target -- the student's own bubble, which session.html marks data-cad="miss" the moment a wrong answer is graded -- and says the nudge there, beside the crossed answer, instead of a bare say from wherever he stood. New moment pages.session.problem.fresh: the first ask after a miss is the fresh problem (vz), and he points at its board (board.latest) so the eye goes from the cross to the new question. The page also shakes and stamps the bubble itself (CSS). Version bumped.

2026-09-08 (ul): THE LANDSCAPE PHONE. `phone.maxHeight` (520): a window no taller than this is a phone too (cadabra.js rule 33), so a phone turned sideways gets the small pencil in the board's corner instead of the full-size one over the composer. Version bumped.

2026-09-08 (uh): THE DEMO TEACHES. pages.demolesson lets him mount on static/demo-lesson.html, the demo's real-lesson excerpt (/demo/lesson). That page drives him itself -- a wave when the excerpt opens, a glance when a question is asked, a celebrate on a right answer -- so its block is empty, like the demo's; it exists so he may mount there at all (rule 18). Version bumped.

2026-09-08 (ug): THE SMALL SCREEN. New `phone` block -- on a window no wider than maxWidth (640) he is `height` 92 instead of 146, rests in the board's top-right corner and does not wander (cadabra.js rule 33). The deep look's phone screenshot had him, at 146, parked over the tutor's first sentence.

2026-09-02 (rr): HE HAS FEELINGS ABOUT YOUR WORK. Jim's behaviour list. New moments on the lesson pages: board.written -> glance (chance 0.5, not more than every 45 s, only after the voice stops and only if nobody is typing); student.stuck -> comfort (listening face, one line from `empathy`, and he STAYS beside the answer box); milestone -> party (stars, arms, a bang on the newest board line, a line from milestone.<kind>); mic.on/off -> the listening face; tutor.thinking/tutor.done -> the chin pose; lesson.start gains a SILENT wave after enter (ri's ruling stands: no joke, no tour, no words while the real voice opens); lesson.end -> a goodbye wave. answer.correct on session also points at the streak star about a third of the time. New line bags: empathy, milestone, milestone.streak/lesson/quiz/unit/course. The [[ink]] tag reaches cadabra.js through the pages, not through this file.

2026-09-01 (rq, same build): the LAB. pages.lab lets him mount on static/cadabra-lab.html, the owner's expression/behaviour bench (it drives the real layer through Cadabra.* directly, so nothing is scheduled here); tours.lab is the three-stop tour that page's Tour button plays.

2026-09-01 (rq): THE ROSTER IS WHOLE AGAIN. Two chats edited this file the same morning: rk (the demo build, 11:40) wrote a demo-only menu at height 118 over rj's (10:50) session/topic/practice menu at height 146 -- so from 11:40 the pencil was OFF in every real lesson and only the demo had him. This file is rj's menu (Jim's 30% ruling, all three lesson pages, the jokes, nudges and tour) PLUS the demo block rk added. Nothing else changed. Version bumped; the battery's version pins now read 'rj or later'.
2026-09-01 (rk): the demo. The demo drives him itself via Cadabra.point() from its own tour, so its block is empty -- it exists so he may mount there at all.

2026-09-01 (rj): BIGGER, AND EVERYWHERE. Jim: 'the pencil needs to be 30% larger and needs to have a slight floating motion.' height 112 -> 146 (+30%), handSize 20 -> 26 in proportion; the float itself is code (cadabra.js, same build). And with the orb retired from the student pages ('he is to be gone everywhere'), the topic and practice entries below are no longer aspirational -- rj wired both pages to this layer, so this menu now runs on all three.

2026-09-01 (ri): THE PENCIL WAKES UP QUIETLY. Jim watched the first live lesson: 'the pencil was floating around pointing at things that didn't match the voice.' The joke and the tour at lesson.start ran WHILE Mr. Cadabra's real recorded voice gave the opening, so the pencil pointed at the answer bar as the voice talked about stars. Ruling applied: at lesson.start he ENTERS and nothing more -- the real voice owns the opening. The joke and tour behaviours still exist in cadabra.js for future scheduling at a quiet moment. Also: the tour's 'problem' stop and the celebrate targets named 'problem' pointed at a data-cad name that exists on no page (rule 30: targets resolve by data-cad name) -- the dead tour stop is removed and the celebrations now aim at 'board', where the problem actually lives.
2026-08-31 (rh/stage2-4): first menu -- entrance, joke, tour, park, celebrate, nudges, clearInk wired to the session page.
jokes: Why was six afraid of seven? Because seven ate nine. I did not write it. I just tell it.
What do you call a number that cannot sit still? A roamin' numeral.
Why did the two fours skip lunch? They already eight.
I told a joke about a broken pencil once. Never mind. It had no point.
What did the zero say to the eight? Nice belt.
Why was the equals sign so humble? It knew it was neither greater nor less than anyone.
Why did the student do multiplication on the floor? The teacher said not to use tables.
What is a math teacher's favourite dessert? Pi. Obviously.

nudges: Take your time. I am not going anywhere.
Have another look at the first step.
Say it out loud. It helps more than you would think.
What is the very next thing you know for certain?
welcome: Right then. Let us have a look at this one.
Good to see you. Ready when you are.
empathy: This one is tricky. Let's do it together.
Take a breath. We will get there, one small step at a time.
Getting stuck is part of learning. I am right here.
Hard ones are how brains grow. Let's look at it again, slowly.
milestone.streak: Three in a row! You are on a roll.
That's a streak! Keep it going.
milestone.lesson: A whole lesson, finished. Well done!
Lesson complete. I am proud of you.
milestone.quiz: Quiz passed! That is real progress.
You passed! I knew you could.
milestone.unit: A whole unit mastered. That is a big deal!
milestone.course: Course Champion! The whole course. I am so proud of you.
You did it. The entire course. Champion!

session.text: Everything I write goes here on the board.
You answer down here. Tap it or type it.
And this counts your run of right answers.

lab.text: Everything I write goes here on the board.
You answer down here. Tap it or type it.
And this counts your run of right answers.

demo._note: The demo drives him directly from its own eleven-stop tour via Cadabra.point(), so there are no scheduled moments here. This block exists so he is allowed to mount on the demo at all.

demolesson._note: The demo's real lesson (uh). demo-lesson.html calls Cadabra.wave/glance/celebrate itself as the excerpt plays, so nothing is scheduled here. This block exists so he is allowed to mount on /demo/lesson at all (rule 18).

lab._note: The owner's bench. Every button on that page calls Cadabra.* directly; this block exists so he may mount there (rule 18).
